verdict.rationale: Discord is a consumer chat platform that holds user messages, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no mention of AI training, data-usage controls, or opt-out settings. The Social SDK social-settings item concerns how players tailor their social experience, not AI training data use, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
